anomalies.description: A chaotic street scene with dense smoke, scattered debris, and multiple individuals engaged in violent unrest; large banners are torn and strewn across the ground, people are moving erratically, some crouching or falling, and police in riot gear are present amid the disorder.; A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals engaged in violent unrest: people are throwing objects, moving aggressively, and a large cloud of smoke (likely tear gas or dust) is spreading across the area. Banners with protest slogans are visible, and police riot shields appear in later frames (f11–f15), indicating a confrontation between protesters and law enforcement.

At least two individuals in the foreground engage in close physical combat: one in red appears to strike or grapple with another person who is bent over or on the ground; movements suggest mutual struggle rather than one-sided attack.

A person in white pants and light top is seen kneeling or crouched over a figure lying motionless on the ground near orange objects (possibly flares or debris); the posture and context suggest possible assault on a helpless individual, though not fully conclusive due to low resolution and smoke.

Two individuals in the foreground (one in red shirt, one in light top) are engaged in close physical combat: they grapple, push, and strike each other repeatedly across frames f0–f6. Their movements indicate mutual aggression rather than one-sided assault.

In frames f7–f10, a person in red lies on the ground while another individual stands over them and appears to strike or kick them; the prone person shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness. This occurs amid ongoing chaos but is distinct from mutual fighting.

At ~12.0s, bright orange flashes appear on the left side of the frame (visible in f0 and f1), consistent with detonation of pyrotechnics or stun grenades; these are brief but distinct bursts of light and smoke expansion, not sustained fire.

A large-scale violent confrontation between a line of riot police (in helmets and shields, forming a barrier in the foreground) and a group of protesters in the background, amid heavy smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), scattered debris, and visible movement suggesting throwing/charging. The scene evolves from initial dispersal to a consolidated police line holding position under ongoing unrest.

Sustained violent unrest with a line of riot police in full gear holding shields, dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) filling the scene, and a crowd of protesters visible in the background behind barricades; movement and tension indicate active confrontation.; Large-scale violent unrest involving a dense crowd of rioters clashing with heavily armored police forces; smoke and debris fill the street, and an armored vehicle is deployed amid ongoing confrontation.; A sustained violent clash between riot police in full gear and a group of protesters on an elevated roadway at night, involving deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters, physical pushing, and crowd dispersal maneuvers.
A bright flash with radiating sparks appears in the mid-background at ~20.0s, consistent with a pyrotechnic explosion (e.g., firework or stun grenade), distinct from ambient lighting or fire.

At least two individuals on elevated walkway (left side) are seen holding firearms in firing posture; muzzle flashes or projectile trajectories are not clearly visible, but repeated aiming and recoil-like motion across frames f9–f15 strongly suggest active gunfire toward the street below.

A sustained violent clash between riot police in full protective gear and a group of protesters on an elevated roadway at night, involving deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters, physical pushing, and crowd dispersal maneuvers.

A figure in dark tactical gear (center-right, near barrier) appears to discharge a projectile-launching device (likely a less-lethal launcher or tear gas grenade), producing a visible muzzle flash/spark and immediate smoke plume at ~37.0s; consistent with non-lethal crowd control firing.
At least one individual is seen being physically struck or thrown backward by a police officer amid the smoke cloud (visible in f3–f4), indicating direct physical combat.

A sustained violent confrontation between riot police and a crowd, involving deployment of an armored vehicle emitting large clouds of smoke (likely tear gas or smoke screen), with officers in full riot gear advancing and individuals in the crowd retreating or raising hands; the scene shows chaotic movement, debris on the ground, and repeated use of force over multiple seconds.

Large-scale violent unrest involving police in riot gear and a crowd, with deployment of tear gas or smoke from an armored vehicle, projectiles being thrown, and escalating confrontation.; Large crowd of protesters and riot police in confrontation; police deploy tear gas or smoke canisters, creating dense clouds; multiple flashes suggest repeated deployment of pyrotechnic devices (e.g., stun grenades or tear gas launchers); vehicles with blue emergency lights are positioned amid the crowd; sustained violent unrest evident across all frames.
A bright flash and rapid expansion of fire/smoke visible near the left side of the road at ~48.5s, consistent with a small explosion (e.g., Molotov cocktail or incendiary device detonation).
A second distinct bright flash and fireball erupts on the right side of the road near the armored vehicle at ~50.5s, indicating another explosion.

Bright, rapid flash and expanding fireball visible in upper left mid-ground at ~53.5s, consistent with a pyrotechnic explosion (e.g., stun grenade or tear gas canister discharge), followed by immediate smoke expansion in f5.

Second distinct bright flash and orange-yellow burst near center-left, slightly later than first, with concurrent smoke plume growth; consistent with another explosive device discharge during ongoing riot.
